marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 25 knots diminishing to northwest 15 late
overnight and to light late Sunday morning. Snow changing to scattered flurries overnight. Visibility
as low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures minus 1 falling to minus 6 Sunday
evening. <br/>
